025public class MineStrikeStats extends BaseShipSystemScript implements MineStrikeStatsAIInfoProvider {
026        
027        protected static float MINE_RANGE = 1000f;
028        
029        public static final float MIN_SPAWN_DIST = 75f;
030        public static final float MIN_SPAWN_DIST_FRIGATE = 110f;
031        
032        public static final float LIVE_TIME = 5f;
033        
034        public static final Color JITTER_COLOR = new Color(255,155,255,75);
035        public static final Color JITTER_UNDER_COLOR = new Color(255,155,255,155);

038        public static float getRange(ShipAPI ship) {
039                if (ship == null) return MINE_RANGE;
040                return ship.getMutableStats().getSystemRangeBonus().computeEffective(MINE_RANGE);

042        
043        public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id, State state, float effectLevel) {
044                ShipAPI ship = null;
045                //boolean player = false;
046                if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
047                        ship = (ShipAPI) stats.getEntity();
048                } else {
049                        return;
050                }
051                
052                
053                float jitterLevel = effectLevel;
054                if (state == State.OUT) {
055                        jitterLevel *= jitterLevel;
056                }
057                float maxRangeBonus = 25f;
058                float jitterRangeBonus = jitterLevel * maxRangeBonus;
059                if (state == State.OUT) {
060                }
061                
062                ship.setJitterUnder(this, JITTER_UNDER_COLOR, jitterLevel, 11, 0f, 3f + jitterRangeBonus);
063                ship.setJitter(this, JITTER_COLOR, jitterLevel, 4, 0f, 0 + jitterRangeBonus);
064                
065                if (state == State.IN) {
066                } else if (effectLevel >= 1) {
067                        Vector2f target = ship.getMouseTarget();
068                        if (ship.getShipAI() != null && ship.getAIFlags().hasFlag(AIFlags.SYSTEM_TARGET_COORDS)){
069                                target = (Vector2f) ship.getAIFlags().getCustom(AIFlags.SYSTEM_TARGET_COORDS);
070                        }
071                        if (target != null) {
072                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(ship.getLocation(), target);
073                                float max = getMaxRange(ship) + ship.getCollisionRadius();
074                                if (dist > max) {
075                                        float dir = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(ship.getLocation(), target);
076                                        target = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(dir);
077                                        target.scale(max);
078                                        Vector2f.add(target, ship.getLocation(), target);
079                                }
080                                
081                                target = findClearLocation(ship, target);
082                                
083                                if (target != null) {
084                                        spawnMine(ship, target);
085                                }
086                        }
087                        
088                } else if (state == State.OUT ) {
089                }
090        }

094        }

096        public void spawnMine(ShipAPI source, Vector2f mineLoc) {
097                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
098                Vector2f currLoc = Misc.getPointAtRadius(mineLoc, 30f + (float) Math.random() * 30f);
099                //Vector2f currLoc = null;
100                float start = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
101                for (float angle = start; angle < start + 390; angle += 30f) {
102                        if (angle != start) {
103                                Vector2f loc = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
104                                loc.scale(50f + (float) Math.random() * 30f);
105                                currLoc = Vector2f.add(mineLoc, loc, new Vector2f());
106                        }
107                        for (MissileAPI other : Global.getCombatEngine().getMissiles()) {
108                                if (!other.isMine()) continue;
109                                
110                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(currLoc, other.getLocation());
111                                if (dist < other.getCollisionRadius() + 40f) {
112                                        currLoc = null;
113                                        break;
114                                }
115                        }
116                        if (currLoc != null) {
117                                break;
118                        }
119                }
120                if (currLoc == null) {
121                        currLoc = Misc.getPointAtRadius(mineLoc, 30f + (float) Math.random() * 30f);
122                }
123                
124                
125                
126                //Vector2f currLoc = mineLoc;
127                MissileAPI mine = (MissileAPI) engine.spawnProjectile(source, null, 
128                                                                                                                          "minelayer2", 
129                                                                                                                          currLoc, 
130                                                                                                                          (float) Math.random() * 360f, null);
131                if (source != null) {
132                        Global.getCombatEngine().applyDamageModifiersToSpawnedProjectileWithNullWeapon(
133                                                                                        source, WeaponType.MISSILE, false, mine.getDamage());
134//                      float extraDamageMult = source.getMutableStats().getMissileWeaponDamageMult().getModifiedValue();
135//                      mine.getDamage().setMultiplier(mine.getDamage().getMultiplier() * extraDamageMult);
136                }
137                
138                
139                float fadeInTime = 0.5f;
140                mine.getVelocity().scale(0);
141                mine.fadeOutThenIn(fadeInTime);
142                
143                Global.getCombatEngine().addPlugin(createMissileJitterPlugin(mine, fadeInTime));
144                
145                //mine.setFlightTime((float) Math.random());
146                float liveTime = LIVE_TIME;
147                //liveTime = 0.01f;
148                mine.setFlightTime(mine.getMaxFlightTime() - liveTime);
149                
150                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("mine_teleport", 1f, 1f, mine.getLocation(), mine.getVelocity());
151        }
152        
153        protected EveryFrameCombatPlugin createMissileJitterPlugin(final MissileAPI mine, final float fadeInTime) {
154                return new BaseEveryFrameCombatPlugin() {
155                        float elapsed = 0f;
156                        @Override
157                        public void advance(float amount, List<InputEventAPI> events) {
158                                if (Global.getCombatEngine().isPaused()) return;
159                        
160                                elapsed += amount;
161                                
162                                float jitterLevel = mine.getCurrentBaseAlpha();
163                                if (jitterLevel < 0.5f) {
164                                        jitterLevel *= 2f;
165                                } else {
166                                        jitterLevel = (1f - jitterLevel) * 2f;
167                                }
168                                
169                                float jitterRange = 1f - mine.getCurrentBaseAlpha();
170                                //jitterRange = (float) Math.sqrt(jitterRange);
171                                float maxRangeBonus = 50f;
172                                float jitterRangeBonus = jitterRange * maxRangeBonus;
173                                Color c = JITTER_UNDER_COLOR;
174                                c = Misc.setAlpha(c, 70);
175                                //mine.setJitter(this, c, jitterLevel, 15, jitterRangeBonus * 0.1f, jitterRangeBonus);
176                                mine.setJitter(this, c, jitterLevel, 15, jitterRangeBonus * 0, jitterRangeBonus);
177                                
178                                if (jitterLevel >= 1 || elapsed > fadeInTime) {
179                                        Global.getCombatEngine().removePlugin(this);
180                                }
181                        }
182                };
183        }

191        @Override
192        public String getInfoText(ShipSystemAPI system, ShipAPI ship) {
193                if (system.isOutOfAmmo()) return null;
194                if (system.getState() != SystemState.IDLE) return null;
195                
196                Vector2f target = ship.getMouseTarget();
197                if (target != null) {
198                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(ship.getLocation(), target);
199                        float max = getMaxRange(ship) + ship.getCollisionRadius();
200                        if (dist > max) {
201                                return "OUT OF RANGE";
202                        } else {
203                                return "READY";
204                        }
205                }
206                return null;
207        }

216        public Vector2f findClearLocation(ShipAPI ship, Vector2f dest) {
217                if (isLocationClear(dest)) return dest;
218                
219                float incr = 50f;
220
221                WeightedRandomPicker<Vector2f> tested = new WeightedRandomPicker<Vector2f>();
222                for (float distIndex = 1; distIndex <= 32f; distIndex *= 2f) {
223                        float start = (float) Math.random() * 360f;
224                        for (float angle = start; angle < start + 360; angle += 60f) {
225                                Vector2f loc = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
226                                loc.scale(incr * distIndex);
227                                Vector2f.add(dest, loc, loc);
228                                tested.add(loc);
229                                if (isLocationClear(loc)) {
230                                        return loc;
231                                }
232                        }
233                }
234                
235                if (tested.isEmpty()) return dest; // shouldn't happen
236                
237                return tested.pick();
238        }
239        
240        public boolean isLocationClear(Vector2f loc) {
241                for (ShipAPI other : Global.getCombatEngine().getShips()) {
242                        if (other.isShuttlePod()) continue;
243                        if (other.isFighter()) continue;
244                        
245//                      Vector2f otherLoc = other.getLocation();
246//                      float otherR = other.getCollisionRadius();
247                        
248//                      if (other.isPiece()) {
249//                              System.out.println("ewfewfewfwe");
250//                      }
251                        Vector2f otherLoc = other.getShieldCenterEvenIfNoShield();
252                        float otherR = other.getShieldRadiusEvenIfNoShield();
253                        if (other.isPiece()) {
254                                otherLoc = other.getLocation();
255                                otherR = other.getCollisionRadius();
256                        }
257                        
258                        
259//                      float dist = Misc.getDistance(loc, other.getLocation());
260//                      float r = other.getCollisionRadius();
261                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(loc, otherLoc);
262                        float r = otherR;
263                        //r = Math.min(r, Misc.getTargetingRadius(loc, other, false) + r * 0.25f);
264                        float checkDist = MIN_SPAWN_DIST;
265                        if (other.isFrigate()) checkDist = MIN_SPAWN_DIST_FRIGATE;
266                        if (dist < r + checkDist) {
267                                return false;
268                        }
269                }
270                for (CombatEntityAPI other : Global.getCombatEngine().getAsteroids()) {
271                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(loc, other.getLocation());
272                        if (dist < other.getCollisionRadius() + MIN_SPAWN_DIST) {
273                                return false;
274                        }
275                }
276                
277                return true;
278        }
